KnowledgeArticle.Title: Crime Stoppers Tip
KnowledgeArticle.Description: Report a tip about a crime.

Section.Name: Crime Stoppers Tip
Section.Content:
You can anonymously report a tip about a crime, or information about a police officer being shot or targeted, through New York City’s Crime Stoppers Hotline and COP SHOT Program. 

Cash rewards are available if the information provided leads to an arrest and an indictment or conviction.

Section.Name: Crime Stoppers Tip
Section.Content:
The City accepts tips regarding individuals wanted for past felony crimes. 

These crimes can include:

  • Murder
  • Shooting
  • Attempted murder
  • Rape
  • Robbery
  • Arson
  • Burglary
  • Any open misdemeanor or felony warrant

You can remain anonymous. If you provide information leading to the arrest and indictment of a person who committed a violent felony, you are eligible for a cash reward of up to $3,500.

You can now send a text message to the Crime Stoppers Hotline

The Hotline does not accept tips on future crimes.

Online

By Phone

Section.Name: COP SHOT Program
Section.Content:
The City accepts information about a police officer being shot or targeted. A $10,000-dollar reward is available to anyone with information that leads to an arrest and conviction. Your call can remain anonymous.

Call 311 or 212-NEW-YORK (212-639-9675) for help.
